text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While out shopping during summer camp, I swing by the beach shack, when…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Welcome, welcome! How many dining today? One? Two? Three dozen?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: What else? I'm running a business! How could I not when this beach house just fell into our laps!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: We're gonna make enough money to renovate this place into a beach palace! In 564 years, they'll be excavating the ruins of it from the seafloor! Right, Nakayama?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh, I wouldn't be surprised, considering you're involved. Might as well completely rethink how the world does business too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I peek inside the establishment but don't find any of the normal workers around. Did these two actually take it over?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Y'know what, you came at just the right time! With you here, this beach family will be unstoppable!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Not even the pressure of the deep sea could crush our bond! This family'll be the best there ever was!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Nakayama's the boss! I'm the struggling student! That seagull's the heroine who protects us from the shadows, and you're our beloved paper cup!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Exactly, we gotta develop our menu first! Can't forget yakisoba noodles with 1,000 times the garam masala! Right, Boss?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Then there's shaved permafrost and ultimate anchovy blast dumplings! Whoa, it's like there's a geyser of inspiration exploding inside me!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: …Sure, sounds good. Go crazy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This makes me nervous in all kinds of ways… but it's lunchtime, and a horde of students is about to come rushing over for a meal!

text_block_list.name: Student Customers
text_block_list.text: "Cascading fireworks tofu"? "Ancient ocean trench soup"? Whoa, what kind of food is this? Should we try it?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. Your yakisoba was really good, Golshi… I want it again.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ahh, you appear before me once more, Stomach Monster! This time I'll hit you with my Thousandfold Garam Masala Yakisoba!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hm?! Wh-what is this?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: …It's delicious!

text_block_list.name: Student Customers
text_block_list.text: Wow, it must be good if Oguri likes it! It's the real deal! Hey, I'll take an order too!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Many thanks! In appreciation for all the business, we're holding a special for the next 564 seconds! Free Himalayan-size upgrades for everyone!

text_block_list.name: Student Customers
text_block_list.text: Awesome! Let me get one too!
choice_data_list: Business is taking off like a rocket!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I had a hunch it'd be way more interesting to let her go wild.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Just look at those people skills… I could never match that.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey, Boss! Paper Cup! Quit gawking around and give me a hand! We need the whole family on this one!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Coming right up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We make it through the rush leaving nothing but satisfied customers! Guess it's time to start closing up shop…

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text: S-sorry! Um, I just want to say… thank you!

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text: This is my grandpa's store. But he got sick from the heat…

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text: He said since everyone from Tracen was excited to come, he'd hate to close the store. He was ready to push himself too hard to keep it open.

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text: But that's when you two said you'd help out.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Oh, don't get the wrong idea. I didn't pitch in because I felt bad or anything.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: It's just, the idea of doing something with someone so unpredictable… sparked my curiosity.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I'm not into following the rules or getting things perfect. That's not what makes my heart sing.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I hope you're ready! Tomorrow we're hauling out a mikoshi shrine rigged with flashy lights to draw in more customers!

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text: Wow! I wanna see that!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh, you're as far from the rules as anyone can get.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: …In that case, why don't we attach the shrine to a cart and take this shack on the road?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ohh, that's great! We can soup it up with those extra jet engines I've got!

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text: R-really?! And what else will you do?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They're really pushing each other outside the box… Through their cooperation, the beach shack becomes a big hit during summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Oh? Then how about we settle this with a contest? Let's see which reigns supreme—bulldozer tracks or boat propeller!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
